Male voice: The default Google Translate voice is female. The brain code uses the Microsoft Edge voice (the Read Aloud feature) for a male voice with an Indonesian accent: id-ID-ArdiNeural. It is free, needs no key, and has no daily quota.

In the brain code, SUARA_EDGE holds the voice name. Indonesian choices: id-ID-ArdiNeural (male) and id-ID-GadisNeural (female). SUARA_EDGE_CEPAT sets the speed (for example +10%) and SUARA_EDGE_NADA the pitch (for example -5Hz for a deeper voice).
The translator uses a native voice for each language: Guy (English), Hamed (Arabic), Keita (Japanese), Yunxi (Mandarin), InJoon (Korean), and Dimas (Javanese).

Change the voice in Setelan → Suara bicara (the order is Edge, Gemini, Google), in the web panel (Musik dan suara section), or in Telegram: /suara edge, /suara gemini, /suara google. Gemini TTS (SUARA_GEMINI, using GEMINI_API_KEY) is still there, but its free daily quota is small.

Why? The robot opens a secure WebSocket connection to the Edge voice server, sends the sentence, and receives MP3 that is written straight to the S3 flash memory (the same FATFS partition required for uploading over WiFi), then plays it. The server asks for a token that changes every 5 minutes; the code calculates it from the robot clock (the same way the edge-tts library does). This is an unofficial service: Microsoft made it for the Edge browser and can change its rules at any time. That is why, if Edge fails, the sentence is spoken right away with the Google voice, so the robot is never silent.
The robot speaks with a male voice. The Serial Monitor prints a line like [suara] Edge 900 ms (id-ID-ArdiNeural), kalimat ke-12 hari ini.

The bot keeps sending "Suara Edge gagal (kode 403)": Microsoft changed the token or the accepted version. The robot uses the Google voice in the meantime. Check the edge-tts library on GitHub (rany2/edge-tts): if there is a new version, copy CHROMIUM_FULL_VERSION from constants.py into EDGE_VERSI in the brain code, then upload again.
Code -107 (clock not synchronized): the robot has not received the time from the internet yet. It usually goes away a few seconds after WiFi connects.
Code -108 (no audio): the name in SUARA_EDGE is misspelled. The capitalization must be exact, for example id-ID-ArdiNeural.
Code -1, -2, or -109: the connection to the server dropped or was slow. The robot tries once more, then uses the Google voice for 2 minutes before trying Edge again.
